title: a clearance refusal that sends a boat to FIXME leaves its component's history and state committed, through the ticket machine's published helper
intention: After clearance.py's _send_to_fixme writes its FIXME crossing, the crossed component's history.json and state.json are committed, path-limited, by calling the ticket machine's published commit helper.
why: Measured 2026-11-19 on akiendell: 2026-11-19 akiendell: five crossings sat uncommitted in the house tree (tester seq 408, codemother seq 172, verdict seq 32, chart_gate seq 9 and 10), landed by hand on akiendell-1eee-fixme-record (0065e73b6). Read: clearance.py:1164 _send_to_fixme calls emit directly (not Ticket.failed), then rewrite_ticket; called from clear at line 1525; nothing commits the crossing it writes, so it leaves dirt by construction. Law 7: a crossing that exists on one disk is not permanent.
traces_to: Law 7 (permanent in records of truth); Law 4 (physics, not a hand remembering sail step 10); RULE 1 (a ticket's build lives inside its own component).
how: A hypothesis, measured by the proof: _send_to_fixme calls cairn.machines.ticket.ticket.commit_crossing_records after its emit. It is not routed through Ticket.failed, because a coverage refusal at PROVED raises no ticket trouble by this function's own docstring, and Ticket.failed does. It depends on ticket 79875eb17ac2 for the helper.

clauses.claim: after the clearance gate's refusal at PROVED sends a boat to FIXME in a scratch repo, the component's history.json and state.json are committed and git status of those two paths is clean
the refusal still raises no ticket trouble and still writes the lacks on the ticket, as before
another ticket's dirty records in the same tree are not staged or committed by the refusal

decisions.text: D1: After clearance.py's _send_to_fixme writes its FIXME crossing, the crossed component's history.json and state.json are committed, path-limited, by calling the ticket machine's published commit helper.
D2: the red-first proof drives a scratch crossing, one tooth per clause, PROVES declared.
